## Reply Triage - Error Handler
Set this as the **Error Workflow** of "Outbound Reply Triage Router" (Workflow settings). It posts a Slack alert for failures outside the action executors (bad payload, invalid config, crashed Code node).
Sandbox mode (default) only previews the alert. Error alerts never include reply content. Use at your own risk - see DISCLAIMER.md.

nodes.name: Sandbox: Error Alert Not Sent
nodes.notes: SANDBOX_MODE is on: the Slack payload is shown here but not posted.
